title: Top Sleeping Bags for Cold Nights (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products from the six cited sources, prioritizing those mentioned in more than one review and covering a range of use cases.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no cost comparison is included.

verdict.line: Picture a solo back‑packer in a 20°F night, using the Questar’s 20F/-6C rating to stay warm while keeping the pack light. It offers a roomy, down‑filled core and a snug hood, making it the only bag here with a true 20F/-6C rating. The catch: it’s heavier than the ultralight options.
